gradient_mpas.accuracy: O(h^2) on a quasi-uniform Voronoi mesh
gradient_mpas.reference: Ringler et al. (2010), J. Comput. Phys. 229:3065-3090, Eq. 22 (TRiSK edge-normal gradient on a C-grid); ESS RFC discretization.md §7.3 worked MPAS-operator family. Discrete operator: (grad phi)_e = (phi_{c2} - phi_{c1}) / dc_edge[e], the edge-normal component of the gradient at edge e, with c1 = cells_on_edge[1,e], c2 = cells_on_edge[2,e] the two cells flanking the edge (the normal points c1->c2, the MPAS 'outward_from_first_cell' convention shared with edge_sign_on_cell), and dc_edge[e] the distance between the two cell centers. The output lives on EDGES (output index ranges over edges, no reduction); 1/dc_edge is build-time-constant grid geometry (const-folded), only phi reaches the per-step hot tree.
